displayDescription: A terracotta kite folds, pleats unfold to carry sage kites outward, and crease links reach small kites on a dark cutting mat.
styleRenderer: Three.js 0.186 WebGLRenderer (orthographic tilted camera, MeshStandardMaterial paper, PCF soft shadows)
motionEngine: GSAP paused timeline registered inline in index.html at window.__timelines.video (single owner of composition time)
Extended Position-Based Dynamics (XPBD) — custom 2D cross-section pleat solver, precomputed at 120 Hz x 8 substeps and replayed from cache
Parent-child crease-hinge pivots (quaternion axis-angle) for kite flaps
limitations: Blender was not used, by explicit user instruction; this is a Three.js approximation of folded paper.
Paper is modelled as rigid zero-thickness facets with a 1.2-unit layer offset; no real paper thickness, fibre texture, bending or crease spring-back.

The XPBD solver is a small custom 2D cross-section solve (inextensible panels, ground contact, soft pleat-memory and compliant end attachment); it isn't a full cloth or origami crease simulator, and pleat memory is an artistic constraint.
Kite flap folds are authored hinge rotations, not simulated; fold order and layer offsets are validated analytically (window.__origamiValidation).
Several sheets are used although the copy reads ONE SHEET; the copy is kept from the reference illustration.
No source frames matched this style (BACKGROUND_REVIEW matchedSources 0); no source observations were used.
The 'a connected system' headline is ivory with a terracotta rule, because terracotta text on the dark mat measured 3.6:1.
